name: Tachibana Yahiro
source:
"I may be a simple costumer, but I am also a regular here, I can find the person you think of, you know?"

— A regular with a keen eye for detail.

A regular at the cafe where the protagonist works. He is a popular customer among the waitresses because of his slender figure, good looks, and soft manner. He always brings a walking stick. He is somewhat mysterious and elusive.

Likes: Friendly chats, Wine
Dislikes: Vexation

[Translated from the [url=https://senju131313.wixsite.com/fukanagigame/post/deitsuagame]official website[/url]]
